slug: 2023-06-27 Paratus to build third Angola data center (DC3, Tier IV)

facts.fact: In November 2023 Paratus secured a US$31 million debt facility from EAIF and Ninety One financing a Luanda data centre and three terrestrial fibre routes, one of them Luanda-Lusaka-Dar es Salaam, so Angola, Zambia and Tanzania are named.
